8	/-!
9	# B-5 at the Abel chart: what the pointwise datum unfolds to, and what it costs
10	
11	`Picard/Pic0ChartCoveragePointwise.lean` reduces `ChartsCoverLocally` — hence B-6 — to a
12	four-part datum at each point of each test.  That reduction is stated for an *arbitrary*
13	family of presheaf maps, so it says nothing about how hard the datum is at the family that
14	matters.  This file instantiates it at `abelSigmaChart` and computes the answer.
15	
16	## The computation, and the one thing it makes visible
17	
18	A section of `pic0SigmaSheaf C` over a **bare** test scheme `T` is by definition a *pair*
19	`⟨a, λ⟩` with `a : T ⟶ Spec k` and `λ` a degree-zero class on the slice object `Over.mk a`
20	(`Over.sigmaExtension`, `Picard/OverSigmaExtension.lean`).  And `(Over.mk a).left` is `T`
21	itself, definitionally.  So the big-site/slice crossing that looks like it needs a bridge does
22	not: the pointwise datum's `t : ↥T` *is* a point of the slice test, and `chartLocus` applies to
23	it with no transport.  `abelChartApp_eq` below records the crossing as an equation rather than
24	leaving it to unfold at a use site.
25	
26	What the computation *does* make visible is where the cost sits.  `abelSigmaChart`'s value at
27	`x : W ⟶ D.left` is `⟨x ≫ D.hom, chartValue … (rep.homEquiv …)⟩`, so matching it against the
28	restriction of `⟨a, λ⟩` needs **both** components: the Σ-component is an equation between
29	morphisms to `Spec k`, and only then is there a class equation.  A producer that supplies the
30	class half alone has not supplied the datum — the Σ-component is what pins the chart point to
31	lie *over* the test, and it is free only because `W.ι ≫ a` is what `D.hom` must equal.
32	
33	## THE CORRECTION THIS FILE CARRIES, against this lane's own headline
34	
35	`Pic0ChartUnivReduce.lean:40` says of its `chartLocusOpens`:
36	
37	> `chartLocusOpens` is **constructed**, not hypothesised — the `W` field costs zero, which is
38	> a real reduction of the datum from four fields to three
39	
40	**The second clause is false, and the roadmap `c9b` row repeats it** ("`W` needs nothing").
41	`chartLocusOpens` takes an argument `haff`, the affine-local openness of the locus at every
42	affine open of the test, and *nothing in the tree discharges it*:
43	`isOpen_chartLocus_of_affineLocal'` (`Pic0ChartLocusIsoInvariance.lean`) removed the
44	`IsSplitWitnessIsoInvariant` hypothesis and passes `haff` straight through, as does
45	`isOpen_chartLocus_of_affineLocal` before it.  The affine case that would feed it is
46	`isOpen_setOf_isSplitWitness_of_presentation` (`Pic0ChartLocusIsOpen.lean:321`), which is
47	itself conditional on `IsChartDatumPresentation` — B-4's *named residue*.
48	
49	**Update, same session** (`Picard/Pic0ChartPresentationConverse.lean`): that residue is now
50	*entirely witness-free*.  Its forward half already was (the trivial splitting), and its
51	converse `hconv` — the descent direction, open for three sessions — is discharged by plus-unit
52	injectivity.  So what `haff` ultimately costs is a `cechPicClass` base-change identity: no
53	witness, no `H¹`, no divisor, and nothing certificate- or divRep-gated.
54	
55	So the honest accounting is: **`W` costs `haff`, which costs B-4's presentation residue.**  The
56	datum went from four fields to three *shapes* but not to three *obligations*.  What is
57	genuinely free is the type-level crossing above, and `chartLocusHaff` below is the residue
58	named so it cannot be lost again.
59	
60	## Main declarations
61	
62	* `AlgebraicGeometry.abelChartApp_eq` — the Abel chart's value at a point of the divisor
63	  scheme, as an explicit `Sigma.mk`.  Both components, since the datum needs both.
64	* `AlgebraicGeometry.ChartLocusAffineLocal` — the `haff` residue, named.  This is what
65	  `chartLocusOpens` silently costs.
66	* `AlgebraicGeometry.chartLocusOpens_of_affineLocal` — `chartLocusOpens` from it, so the
67	  dependency is explicit in the API rather than in an argument position.
68	* `AlgebraicGeometry.chartLocusAffineLocal_of_presentation` — the residue **reduced to B-4's
69	  own named obligation**: a per-affine-piece `IsChartDatumPresentation` gives it.  This is the
70	  link that was asserted in `Pic0ChartLocusIsOpen`'s docstring and never written.
71	-/

82	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
83	
84	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
85	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom π] {n : ℕ}
86	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
87	variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

89	noncomputable section

91	/-! ## The Abel chart's value, both components -/
92	
93	/-- **The Abel chart map evaluated at a point of the divisor scheme.**
94	
95	`abelSigmaChart` is `rep.toSigmaExtension ≫ Over.sigmaExtensionNat (chartValueTrans …)`, and
96	both factors act componentwise on the Σ-extension, so the value at `x : Y ⟶ D.left` is the
97	pair whose structure morphism is `x ≫ D.hom` and whose class is the chart value of the divisor
98	family `rep.homEquiv (Over.homMk x rfl)`.
99	
100	Recorded as an equation because a coverage producer has to match this against a *given*
101	section, and the match is two equations rather than one: the Σ-components must agree before
102	the classes are even in the same type.  Leaving it to unfold at the use site is how the
103	Σ-component gets forgotten. -/
104	@[simp]
105	theorem abelChartApp_eq {D : Over (Spec (.of k))} (rep : (divFunctor C π n).RepresentableBy D)
106	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
107	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
108	      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (n : ℤ))
109	    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (x : Y ⟶ D.left) :
110	    (abelSigmaChart C π n rep m Z hdeg).app (op Y) x
111	      = ⟨x ≫ D.hom, ⟨chartValue C π n m Z (Over.mk (x ≫ D.hom))
112	          (rep.homEquiv (Over.homMk x rfl)),
113	        chartValue_mem_pic0Subgroup C π n m Z hdeg _ _⟩⟩ :=
114	  rfl
115	
116	/-! ## The `haff` residue, named
117	
118	`chartLocusOpens` takes the affine-local openness as an argument.  Naming it is not cosmetic:
119	an argument in a definition's signature is invisible to a census of open obligations, which is
120	how "the `W` field costs zero" survived into two roadmap rows. -/
121	
122	variable (C) in
123	/-- **The affine-local openness residue of `chartLocus`** — what `chartLocusOpens` costs.
124	
125	For a test `T` and a class `lam` on it, this says the chart locus is open over every affine
126	open piece of `T`.  It is exactly the `haff` argument of `isOpen_chartLocus_of_affineLocal'`,
127	and it is the *only* remaining input to CHART-U(b) at a general test: the iso-invariance
128	hypothesis that used to sit beside it was discharged
129	(`isSplitWitnessIsoInvariant_holds`), but this one was passed through, not proved.
130	
131	Named as a `Prop` so that it appears in searches for open obligations. -/
132	def ChartLocusAffineLocal (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
133	    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (lam : picEt C T) : Prop :=
134	  ∀ U : T.left.affineOpens,
135	    IsOpen (chartLocus C m Z (picEtMap C (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) lam))
136	
137	variable (C) in
138	/-- `chartLocusOpens` with its cost made explicit in the API.
139	
140	Identical in content to `chartLocusOpens` — the point is that the dependency is now a named
141	`Prop` a reader can grep for, rather than an unnamed argument that reads as bookkeeping. -/
142	def chartLocusOpens' (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
143	    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (lam : picEt C T)
144	    (haff : ChartLocusAffineLocal C m Z T lam) : T.left.Opens :=
145	  chartLocusOpens C m Z T lam haff
146	
147	@[simp]
148	lemma mem_chartLocusOpens' {m : ℕ} {Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor}
149	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} {lam : picEt C T} {haff : ChartLocusAffineLocal C m Z T lam}
150	    {t : T.left} :
151	    t ∈ chartLocusOpens' C m Z T lam haff ↔ t ∈ chartLocus C m Z lam :=
152	  Iff.rfl
153	
154	/-! ## Reducing the residue to B-4's own named obligation
155	
156	`Pic0ChartLocusIsOpen.lean:321`'s docstring says the general-test statement follows from the
157	affine one "by the affine-piece locality of the (b-amendment)'s transport (iii)", and adds that
158	it "is not stated here only because it would need the presentation hypothesis *per affine
159	piece*".  That is right, and this is the statement it describes. -/
160	
161	set_option linter.overlappingInstances false in
162	variable (C π) in
163	/-- **The `haff` residue from a per-affine-piece presentation** — the link
164	`Pic0ChartLocusIsOpen`'s docstring describes and does not state.
165	
166	For each affine open `U` of the test, a `BasicOpenCocycleDatum` over `Γ(T.left, U)` presenting
167	the restricted twisted class gives openness of the locus on that piece
168	(`isOpen_setOf_isSplitWitness_of_presentation`), and `chartLocus` over the piece *is* that set
169	by definition (`chartLocus` unfolds to the split-witness set of the twisted class, and the
170	twist commutes with restriction by `picEtMap_chartTwist`).
171	
172	So the affine-local residue is **exactly** B-4's presentation obligation, quantified over
173	affine pieces — no extra geometry, and in particular nothing certificate- or divRep-gated.
174	Combined with `isOpen_chartLocus_of_affineLocal'` this closes CHART-U(b) at a general test the
175	moment `IsChartDatumPresentation` is available per piece.
176	
177	The `hπ` and `IsFinite π` hypotheses are the ones
178	`isOpen_setOf_isSplitWitness_of_presentation` carries.  `IsFinite π` is strictly stronger than
179	the file-level `IsAffineHom π` (whence the overlapping-instance warning, disabled below): the
180	affine openness route runs through the rigid engine, which needs finiteness, while the rest of
181	this file needs only affineness. -/
182	theorem chartLocusAffineLocal_of_presentation [IsFinite π]
183	    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
184	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
185	    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (lam : picEt C T)
186	    (hpres : ∀ U : T.left.affineOpens,
187	      ∃ D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C (Γ(T.left, U.1)) π,
188	        IsChartDatumPresentation C π
189	          (chartTwist C m Z _ (picEtMap C (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) lam)) D) :
190	    ChartLocusAffineLocal C m Z T lam := by
191	  intro U
192	  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := hpres U
193	  exact isOpen_setOf_isSplitWitness_of_presentation C π hπ hD
194	
195	end
196	
197	end AlgebraicGeometry

216	/-! ## The Abel transformation at an arbitrary test -/
217	
218	section AbelVehicle
219	
220	variable (C π n) in
221	/-- **The Abel transformation at an arbitrary test object** (worksheet §4.1, the
222	vehicle lift): componentwise over the affine opens, compatible by the affine
223	naturality. -/
224	def abelDiv (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (s : divFamZar C π n T) : picEt C T :=
225	  ⟨fun U => abelDivPlus C π Γ(T.left, U.1) (s.1 U), fun U V h => by
226	    rw [abelDivPlus_mapAlgHom (Over.resAlgHom T h) (s.1 V), s.compat U V h]⟩
227	
228	@[simp]
229	lemma abelDiv_val (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (s : divFamZar C π n T)
230	    (U : T.left.affineOpens) :
231	    (abelDiv C π n T s).1 U = abelDivPlus C π Γ(T.left, U.1) (s.1 U) :=
232	  rfl
233	
234	/-- The affine collapse of the vehicle-level Abel transformation: definitionally the
235	affine naturality law at the `ΓSpecIso` identification. -/
236	theorem picEtAffineEquiv_abelDiv (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
237	    (s : divFamZar C π n (overSpec k A)) :
238	    picEtAffineEquiv C A (abelDiv C π n (overSpec k A) s)
239	      = abelDivPlus C π A (divFamZarAffineEquiv C π n A s) :=
240	  abelDivPlus_mapAlgHom (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k A).toAlgHom
241	    (s.1 (overSpecTopAffine A))
242	
243	/-- On an affine test the vehicle-level Abel transformation is the affine one, through
244	the comparison equivalences. -/
245	theorem abelDiv_overSpec (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
246	    (s : divFamZar C π n (overSpec k A)) :
247	    abelDiv C π n (overSpec k A) s
248	      = abelDivAff C π A (divFamZarAffineEquiv C π n A s) :=
249	  (picEtAffineEquiv C A).injective
250	    ((picEtAffineEquiv_abelDiv A s).trans
251	      (picEtAffineEquiv_abelDivAff A (divFamZarAffineEquiv C π n A s)).symm)
252	
253	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
254	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
255	
256	/-- **Naturality of the Abel transformation in the test object**: restriction of the
257	Abel value along an arbitrary test morphism is the Abel value of the restricted
258	family — through the `∃!`-characterizations of both glued restrictions. -/
259	theorem picEtMap_abelDiv {T T' : Over (Spec (.of k))} (f : T' ⟶ T)
260	    (s : divFamZar C π n T) :
261	    picEtMap C f (abelDiv C π n T s) = abelDiv C π n T' (divFamZar.map C π n f s) := by
262	  refine picEt.ext fun W => ?_
263	  rw [picEtMap_val]
264	  refine picEtMapVal_eq_of C f (abelDiv C π n T s) ?_
265	  intro W₀ hW₀ V hV
266	  rw [abelDiv_val, abelDiv_val, divFamZar.map_val,
267	    abelDivPlus_mapAlgHom (Over.resAlgHom T' hW₀) (divFamZar.mapVal C π n f s W),
268	    abelDivPlus_mapAlgHom (Over.appLEAlgHom f V.1 W₀.1 hV) (s.1 V),
269	    divFamZar.mapVal_spec C π n f s W W₀ hW₀ V hV]
270	
271	/-! ## The degree ledger -/
272	
273	/-- **The degree ledger** (worksheet §4.2): the Abel value of a degree-`n` family has
274	degree `n` at every field point — naturality reduces to the affine collapse at the
275	field, `degAff_unit` + `relPicDeg_relPicMk` read the class degree, and the field-level
276	degree law finishes. -/
277	theorem degAt_abelDiv {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (s : divFamZar C π n T) {K : Type u}
278	    [Field K] [Algebra k K] (t : overSpec k K ⟶ T) :
279	    degAt (abelDiv C π n T s) t = (n : ℤ) := by
280	  haveI : IsIntegral (relCurve C K) := instIsIntegralBaseChange C K
281	  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (relCurve C K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :=
282	    instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionBaseChange C K
283	  haveI : QuasiCompact (relCurve C K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :=
284	    instQuasiCompactBaseChange C K
285	  haveI : Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C K).moduleKSheaf K) 0) :=
286	    instModuleFiniteHModuleZeroBaseChange C K
287	  haveI : Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C K).moduleKSheaf K) 1) :=
288	    instModuleFiniteHModuleOneBaseChange C K
289	  change PicEtAff.degAff K (picEtAffineEquiv C K
290	      (picEtMap C t (abelDiv C π n T s))) = (n : ℤ)
291	  rw [picEtMap_abelDiv, picEtAffineEquiv_abelDiv]
292	  change PicEtAff.degAff K (PicEtAff.unit C K (relPicMk C (overSpec k K)
293	      (divFamZarAffineEquiv C π n K (divFamZar.map C π n t s)).picClass)) = (n : ℤ)
294	  rw [PicEtAff.degAff_unit, relPicDeg_relPicMk]
295	  exact DivFamZar.classDeg_picClass _
296	
297	variable (C π n) in
298	/-- **The Abel natural transformation into the degree-`n` layer** (the sharpened
299	dat-d Addendum row, worksheet §4.2): the Abel transformation, ledgered by
300	`degAt_abelDiv`, as a natural transformation
301	`divFunctor C π n ⟶ picDegLayerFunctor C n`. -/
302	def abelDivTrans : divFunctor C π n ⟶ picDegLayerFunctor C (n : ℤ) where
303	  app T := ↾fun s => ⟨abelDiv C π n T.unop s, fun K _ _ t => degAt_abelDiv s t⟩
304	  naturality T T' g := by
305	    ext s
306	    refine Subtype.ext ?_
307	    exact (picEtMap_abelDiv g.unop s).symm
308	
309	@[simp]
310	lemma abelDivTrans_app_coe (T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ) (s : divFamZar C π n T.unop) :
311	    ((abelDivTrans C π n).app T s).1 = abelDiv C π n T.unop s :=
312	  rfl
313	
314	end AbelVehicle

316	/-! ## The Σ-family and the chart value -/
317	
318	section Sigma
319	
320	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
321	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
322	
323	variable (C) in
324	/-- **The Σ-family** (worksheet §3.2): the DAT-5 base-class pullback mechanism reused
325	at the class `𝒪(Z)` of a Weil divisor `Z` on the base-changed curve `C_k`. -/
326	def sigmaFamily (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor) (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) :
327	    picEt C T :=
328	  thetaFamily C (Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass k Z) T
329	
330	variable (C) in
331	/-- Naturality of the Σ-family: it pulls back to itself under every test map. -/
332	theorem sigmaFamily_natural (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
333	    {T T' : Over (Spec (.of k))} (f : T' ⟶ T) :
334	    picEtMap C f (sigmaFamily C Z T) = sigmaFamily C Z T' :=
335	  thetaFamily_natural C _ f
336	
337	variable (C) in
338	/-- **The degree of the Σ-family at every field point is `deg k Z`** (E-iv-alg under
339	the DAT-5 degree law + E-i). -/
340	theorem degAt_sigmaFamily (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
341	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
342	    (t : overSpec k K ⟶ T) :
343	    degAt (sigmaFamily C Z T) t = Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z := by
344	  change degAt (thetaFamily C (Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass k Z) T) t = _
345	  rw [degAt_thetaFamily, classDeg_picClass]
346	
347	variable (C π n) in
348	/-- **The chart value** (worksheet §3.2): the Abel value shifted by the Σ-family and
349	`m` inverse powers of the pinned θ-family,
350	`abelDiv s · sigmaFamily Z · (θ_T^m)⁻¹`. -/
351	def chartValue (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
352	    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (s : divFamZar C π n T) : picEt C T :=
353	  abelDiv C π n T s * sigmaFamily C Z T
354	    * (thetaFamily C (thetaCechClass C) T ^ m)⁻¹
355	
356	variable (C π n) in
357	/-- Naturality of the chart value in the test object. -/
358	theorem picEtMap_chartValue (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
359	    {T T' : Over (Spec (.of k))} (f : T' ⟶ T) (s : divFamZar C π n T) :
360	    picEtMap C f (chartValue C π n m Z T s)
361	      = chartValue C π n m Z T' (divFamZar.map C π n f s) := by
362	  rw [chartValue, chartValue, map_mul, map_mul, map_inv, map_pow, picEtMap_abelDiv,
363	    sigmaFamily_natural, thetaFamily_natural]
364	
365	variable (C π n) in
366	/-- **The degree of the chart value at every field point**:
367	`n + deg k Z − m·d₁` — the §4.2 ledger summed across the three factors. -/
368	theorem degAt_chartValue (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
369	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (s : divFamZar C π n T) {K : Type u} [Field K]
370	    [Algebra k K] (t : overSpec k K ⟶ T) :
371	    degAt (chartValue C π n m Z T s) t
372	      = (n : ℤ) + Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
373	        - (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) := by
374	  rw [chartValue, degAt_mul, degAt_mul, degAt_inv, degAt_thetaFamily_pow,
375	    degAt_abelDiv, degAt_sigmaFamily]
376	  ring
377	
378	variable (C π n) in
379	/-- **The chart value lands in `pic0`** (worksheet §3.2/§4.2, the chart-index degree
380	ledger): under the chart-index constraint `deg k Z = m·d₁ − n` the three degrees sum
381	to zero at every field point. -/
382	theorem chartValue_mem_pic0Subgroup (m : ℕ)
383	    (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
384	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
385	      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (n : ℤ))
386	    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (s : divFamZar C π n T) :
387	    chartValue C π n m Z T s ∈ pic0Subgroup C T := by
388	  rw [mem_pic0Subgroup_iff]
389	  intro K _ _ t
390	  rw [degAt_chartValue, hdeg]
391	  ring
392	
393	end Sigma
394	
395	end
396	
397	end AlgebraicGeometry

10	/-!
11	# CHART-U(b) at a general test, from the plus-class identity alone
12	
13	## What this file is
14	
15	The endpoint of the CHART-U(b) chain, assembled.  Reading the chain from the bottom up, the
16	general-test openness `isOpen_chartLocus` rested on:
17	
18	| input | supplied by |
19	|---|---|
20	| iso-invariance of the split predicate | `isSplitWitnessIsoInvariant_holds` (landed, r5) |
21	| `haff` — affine-local openness | `ChartLocusAffineLocal`, **named** at r6 |
22	| `haff` from a per-piece presentation | `chartLocusAffineLocal_of_presentation` (r6) |
23	| `IsChartDatumPresentation` from `hfib` + `hplus` | `isChartDatumPresentation_of_plusFibre` (r6) |
24	| **`hplus` from `hfib`** | **`isChartDatumPlusFibreAt_of_isScalarTower` (r7)** |
25	
26	Only the last row was missing, and it was missing while being cited by name — see
27	`Picard/Pic0ChartPlusFibreTower.lean`'s header for that correction.  With it the chain composes,
28	and this file states the composite so that no consumer has to rebuild it.
29	
30	## What the resulting hypothesis is, precisely
31	
32	`isOpen_chartLocus_of_plusFibre` below asks, for each affine open `U` of the test, for a
33	`BasicOpenCocycleDatum` over `Γ(T.left, U)` satisfying `IsChartDatumPlusFibre` — one equation of
34	plus classes per point of `U`.  That hypothesis is:
35	
36	* **witness-free, `H¹`-free and divisor-free.**  No effective divisor, no vanishing cohomology, no
37	  degree.  This matters because those three are exactly what the certificate lane produces, and
38	  their absence is why this leg was always developable ahead of CERT-Σ.
39	* **certificate-free and divRep-free** — and the instrument matters here, because the obvious one
40	  gives the wrong answer.  This module's **import closure is not certificate-free**: it reaches
41	  `DivSchemeCertificate`, `DivSchemeClassify*` and `Pic0AtlasFromDivRep` along
42	  `Pic0ChartLocusFibreField → DivisorFamilyH1Locus → DivRepClassifyZarKit → …`, purely incidentally
43	  (the fibre-field file wants an `H¹` locus, which lives in a module that also serves the
44	  classifier).  So "no certificate module in the imports" is false, and a lane checking
45	  certificate-freedom by grepping imports would wrongly conclude this leg is gated.
46	  What is true is the statement about the **theorems**: walking the transitive *constant*
47	  dependencies of `isOpen_chartLocus_of_plusFibre` (7445 constants) and
48	  `chartLocusAffineLocal_of_plusFibre` (7448) yields **zero** constants whose name contains
49	  `Cert`, `DivFamZar`, `FinCover`, `Classify`, `DivRep` or `divRep`.  Availability is cone-relative
50	  and so is gatedness: measure the declaration's own closure, not the module's imports.
51	* **not vacuous.**  `IsChartDatumPlusFibre` is a genuine equation between plus classes — `rfl` and
52	  `simp` both fail on it at arbitrary `μ`, `D` (measured; recorded on
53	  `isChartDatumPlusFibreAt_self` and re-run for the transport).
54	* **inhabited.**  `exists_splitting_of_picEt` produces, unconditionally on the curve and at any
55	  reading field, a presenting class with exactly this shape — so the hypothesis is satisfiable,
56	  not a reduction to a false premise.  (Both halves of the probe, per the rule this project's
57	  lanes converged on: run the direction matching which arguments the consumer chooses.)
58	
59	## What is still NOT closed, stated so the file is not over-read
60	
61	The hypothesis is a *per-affine-piece existence of a datum with the plus-class property*, and
62	nothing here produces such a datum.  Producing one is a different obligation from anything above:
63	it is the identification of the datum's fibre class with `μ`'s fibre, i.e. the content the c9b row
64	calls the presentation, and for the specific `μ` of the Σ-chart it is where the twist bookkeeping
65	of `w4-datb` §1.2 enters.  So this file closes CHART-U(b) *modulo a producer*, which is strictly
66	what the chain above it needed, and does not claim the producer.
67	
68	In particular this is **not** a claim about `c9b`'s clause (ii).  That clause is the property half
69	of `IsChartUniv` and remains CERT-Σ/divRep-gated through `IsChartLocusFibre`'s `exists_factor`;
70	nothing in this file touches it.  What this file removes is clause (i)'s cost — the `W` field, i.e.
71	the chart-locus open — which the c9b row priced at zero, then correctly re-priced at "B-4 through
72	`haff`", and which is now genuinely discharged from a witness-free hypothesis.
73	
74	## Main declarations
75	
76	* `AlgebraicGeometry.chartLocusAffineLocal_of_plusFibre` — `haff` from a per-piece
77	  `IsChartDatumPlusFibre`.
78	* `AlgebraicGeometry.isOpen_chartLocus_of_plusFibre` — **CHART-U(b) at a general test** from that
79	  hypothesis alone.
80	* `AlgebraicGeometry.chartLocusOpensOfPlusFibre` — the open of the test as data, which is the
81	  shape the `W` field of a chart datum consumes.
82	-/

151	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
152	    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (lam : picEt C T)
153	    (hfib : ∀ U : T.left.affineOpens,
154	      ∃ D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C (Γ(T.left, U.1)) π,
155	        IsChartDatumPlusFibre C π
156	          (chartTwist C m Z _ (picEtMap C (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) lam)) D) :
157	    IsOpen (chartLocus C m Z lam) :=

164

166	but the `T.left.Opens` it determines.  `chartLocusOpens'` already takes `ChartLocusAffineLocal` as

171	and a lane holding only `IsOpen (chartLocus …)` still has to build the bundled `Opens` — which is
172	exactly the step at which the `haff` cost got lost the first time. -/
173	def chartLocusOpensOfPlusFibre
174	    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
175	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
176	    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (lam : picEt C T)
177	    (hfib : ∀ U : T.left.affineOpens,
178	      ∃ D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C (Γ(T.left, U.1)) π,
179	        IsChartDatumPlusFibre C π
180	          (chartTwist C m Z _ (picEtMap C (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) lam)) D) :
181	    T.left.Opens :=
182	  chartLocusOpens' C m Z T lam (chartLocusAffineLocal_of_plusFibre C π hπ m Z T lam hfib)
183	
184	@[simp]
185	lemma mem_chartLocusOpensOfPlusFibre
186	    {hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom}
187	    {m : ℕ} {Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor}
188	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} {lam : picEt C T}
189	    {hfib : ∀ U : T.left.affineOpens,
190	      ∃ D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C (Γ(T.left, U.1)) π,
191	        IsChartDatumPlusFibre C π
192	          (chartTwist C m Z _ (picEtMap C (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) lam)) D}
193	    {t : T.left} :
194	    t ∈ chartLocusOpensOfPlusFibre C π hπ m Z T lam hfib ↔ t ∈ chartLocus C m Z lam :=
195	  Iff.rfl
